scope: Fixed source, face/body references, seed and cached conditioning; 24 source frames plus 48 delivered continuation frames at 24 fps; full 20-step CPU oracle
background: top 23 percent or left 25 percent, excluding a four-pixel border
metric: Upper-decile spatial mean of motion-compensated flow acceleration and jerk in the subject ROI; continuity score = sqrt(mean(acceleration^2) + 0.25*mean(jerk^2)). Units are pixels per frame squared/cubed; report the components separately.
completion: Primary action must pass on selection and confirmation seeds; unchanged prompt must pass both seeds; changed-action aggregate must pass; all chosen comparisons require a recorded visual review without major degradation. Numerical proxies alone cannot establish character identity or action quality.
conditional_tasks: Token reduction remains disabled; T060 is not activated. GPU/reuse acceptance is separate from the motion-quality gate. Failed quality gates keep the feature unqualified and T065 open.
